basis: The Fed raised rates 25 bp to 3.75%-4.00%; the unanimous vote and projections pointing to another likely 2026 hike were incrementally hawkish.

Cash markets closed lower after the initial relief response reversed: Dow -1.21%, S&P 500 about -0.44%, Nasdaq approximately flat; the 2-year yield rose near 4.725%, the 10-year held around 5%, and the dollar strengthened.

Overnight futures are now testing whether the Fed move was fully absorbed or overextended. Penalize chasing, require completed 5m/15m acceptance, and distinguish continuation from a reclaim/mean-reversion.

Gold and silver remain pressured by the stronger dollar and rates, but oversold momentum can produce sharp countertrend rebounds. Crude fell sharply on supply rerouting and inventory disappointment; the Fed remains secondary to energy-specific catalysts.
Thin overnight liquidity increases wick and false-break risk. Structural stops, retests, and no-chase boundaries remain mandatory.
macro_context.trading_week_posture: BEARISH RISK ASSETS / REVERSAL-SENSITIVE AFTER EVENT EXTENSION
